correctness.rationale: Parseval gives a pairwise 2×2 Hermitian Fourier symbol with top eigenvalue cos(t)cosθ+sqrt(a²+sin²t sin²θ); long two-frequency blocks show this upper bound is exact as supremum. Scalar strict concavity gives the stated a|cosθ| vs sin²θ threshold, and weakly-null shift translates every numerical value to the essential range. Equality in Fourier integral would force Hardy L² support on finitely many frequencies, impossible; convexity of W then gives exactly the interior of the essential closed range. Independent real symmetric 160×160 quadratic-form tests for four a values and six directions corroborate 24 supports, not the infinite-dimensional proof.
